message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a dark background. At the top, the white title "TEMPO" is partially obscured by an illustration of a yellow excavator with a jointed boom and bucket. Below the title, two cupped human hands hold a large, reddish-brown mound of rocky soil. The excavator sits atop this mound, its arm extended.

At the bottom, white and red text reads "INVESTIGASI" above a larger white title "Jabal Nikel Ilegal." Further down, smaller white text states: "Tambang nikel tanpa izin marak di Sulawesi. Dalam perlindungan aparat dan aturan sapu jagat. H.46". 

The upper left corner has a red rectangle with white text: "Basa-basi Pengakuan Pelanggaran HAM H.20". To its right, white text reads: "Insentif Kendaraan Listrik H.70". Information in the upper right includes "23-29 JANUARI 2023", "RP 50.000", "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273" beside a barcode and QR code. The hands are rendered with visible brushstrokes, showing light and shadow across the fingers and palms. The soil is composed of various-sized jagged lumps.
